label: По-своему
description: A 10-sentence card for fixed expressions built on свой.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Своими руками, by oneself. This fixed phrase uses the plural instrumental своими agreeing with руками and means done with one's own hands. Свой still points back to the subject я.
Strategic focus: В своё время, in due course. The neuter accusative своё agrees with время in this set expression meaning at the right moment. The form is frozen but keeps its reflexive sense.
Strategic focus: По-своему, in one's own way. This adverbial idiom is built on свой and means acting on one's own terms. It points back to the subject он, the same-subject logic of свой.

missions.phrase: На вечеринке я был не в своей тарелке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Не в своей тарелке, ill at ease. The feminine prepositional своей agrees with тарелке in this idiom meaning out of one's element. Literally not in one's own plate.

missions.phrase: После новостей он был сам не свой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Сам не свой, not oneself. This fixed phrase uses masculine свой to describe being out of sorts. It refers to the subject он, in line with the reflexive rule.

missions.phrase: Этот мастер уникален в своём роде.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: В своём роде, in its own way. The masculine prepositional своём agrees with роде in this idiom meaning one of a kind. The form stays reflexive to its subject.
Strategic focus: Своими руками, by oneself. The plural instrumental своими agrees with руками and signals work done personally. Свой points back to the subject она.
Strategic focus: В своё время, in due course. The neuter accusative своё agrees with время in this frozen idiom about timing. It stays tied to the subject мы.
Strategic focus: По-своему, in one's own way. This adverb from свой means each in his own fashion. It refers back to the subject каждый, following the same-subject rule of свой.

missions.phrase: Сегодня я какой-то сам не свой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Сам не свой, not oneself. The masculine свой in this idiom describes feeling off. It refers to the subject я, keeping the reflexive sense of свой.
